note: Catalogue capture uplifted in part to the held tier-2 Toyota Land Cruiser Chassis and Body Repair Manual (10/84 to 1/90). The manual publishes the 70 series wheelbase, the tyre size code and the normal-road tyre pressure at grade documented. It publishes no overall length, width, height or transmission datum, so those fields are retained from the tier-5 English Wikipedia article at grade claimed.

length_mm.state: short-wheelbase length published as 4,995 mm; the same row publishes 5,245 mm for the long-wheelbase

width_mm.state: width published as 1,790 to 1,870 mm; the lower bound taken

height_mm.state: height published as 1,955 mm; the same row publishes 2,070 mm

wheelbase_mm.locator: BODY — Frame Dimensions, FJ, BJ 70 Series drawing, wheelbase dimension 2,310 (90.94), printed page BO-119
wheelbase_mm.state: wheelbase published as 2,310 mm for the FJ and BJ 70 series

transmission_type.state: transmission published as a 4 or 5-speed manual, with 4-speed and 6-speed automatics also listed

tyre_size_text.locator: SERVICE SPECIFICATIONS — Front Axle and Suspension, tyre pressure table, FJ70 and BJ70 series rows, printed page A-10
tyre_size_text.state: tyre size published as 7.50-16-6PRLT for the FJ70 and BJ70 series; the table also lists 7.50-16-8PRLT and 7.50R-16-8PRLT

tyre_pressure_kpa.locator: SERVICE SPECIFICATIONS — Front Axle and Suspension, tyre pressure table, FJ70 series, 7.50-16-6PRLT row, below 80 km/h column, printed page A-10
tyre_pressure_kpa.state: tyre pressure published as 1.8 kgf/cm2 (26 psi, 177 kPa) below 80 km/h; recorded as 177 kPa
